open_point_recommendation.question: Vacation compensated in cash / paid on termination in the parafiscal (CCF, SENA, ICBF) base (campos 45 and 95).
open_point_recommendation.ugpp_status: The UGPP is the competent contribution-control authority (created by Ley 1151/2007 art. 156, with the function of following up and determining the adequate, complete and timely settlement and payment of social-protection parafiscal contributions; the guide's p.1 states 'Creación de la entidad: Ley 1151 Julio 24 de 2007'. The Ley 1151 text is not held locally, so art. 156 wording was not re-read). The document is an official UGPP publication (ugpp.gov.co/sites/default/files/Parafiscales/Empleadores-IBC-2021.pdf) but a 2021 guidance slide deck (PDF metadata 'Presentación de PowerPoint', 2021-05-05), not a resolution, concepto or acuerdo: persuasive and indicative of how the auditor assesses, not binding law.
open_point_recommendation.ugpp_quote: p.23: 'Incluir en el IBC el valor pagado de las vacaciones disfrutadas, compensadas en dinero o pagadas por liquidación de contrato, para el cálculo de los aportes parafiscales (Ley 21 de 1982, artículo 17).' pp.22-23 diagram: 'IBC PARAF = Total pagos salariales + Total pagado por Vacaciones'.
open_point_recommendation.ley21_reading: Art. 17: '[...] se entiende por nómina mensual de salarios la totalidad de los pagos hechos por concepto de los diferentes elementos integrantes del salario [...] y además, los verificados por descansos remunerados de ley y convencionales o contractuales.' Payments 'verificados por descansos remunerados de ley' textually cover payments made on account of statutory paid rest; vacation is the statutory paid rest and its cash compensation or termination payment is a payment on account of that rest. 'Además' brings these payments into the base even though they are not salary. The statute does not name compensation expressly, so inclusion rests on the statute read with the UGPP's published reading.
open_point_recommendation.recommendation: Include compensated and termination vacation in campo 45 and campo 95, citing Ley 21/1982 art. 17 as the rule and UGPP 'Ingreso base de cotización - Empleadores' (2021) p.23 as the competent authority's reading. Risk is asymmetric: excluding it exposes the employer to a UGPP inexactitud assessment with interest and sanctions; including it costs only the parafiscal contributions. For ICBF, confirm Ley 89/1988 art. 1 ('nómina mensual de salarios') before stating it by statute. Decision is Wallisson's; no edit made.
